### MPH Candidate in Epidemiology | Columbia University

Welcome! I'm a graduate student at Columbia University's
Mailman School of Public Health, where I'm pursuing an MPH
in Epidemiology with a certificate in Chronic Disease
Epidemiology.

My research interests lie at the intersection of
**cerebrovascular health, cognitive aging, and Alzheimer's
disease**, with a focus on understanding how
vascular risk factors contribute to cognitive impairment
and dementia.

I currently conduct research in the Brickman Lab at
Columbia University's Taub Institute for Research on
Alzheimer's Disease and the Aging Brain. Previously,
I worked as a Clinical Research Associate at the
Yale Stroke Center.

I earned my BA in Psychology from the University of
California, Berkeley, where I was a Division I
student-athlete on the women's rowing team.
